beats.say: Hippos can't swim. They can't even float.
So I shrank myself down, and hopped into the river with one.
The hippopotamus. A big male can weigh nearly ten thousand pounds.
It's too heavy to float, so it gallops along the bottom of the river.
It can hold its breath for five minutes or more.
It even sleeps underwater. It floats up for air and sinks back down, still asleep.
Subscribe. Next, a deer that dives underwater to eat.
